name: Kuromiya Ichika
source:
A cheerful, nerdy, NEET cat girl.

She spends her days fully immersed in the entertainment of the human world. She's the most knowledgeable about human affairs. Her hobbies include the internet, gaming, and manga, and she basically lives like a NEET.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/amayakasi/character_0000.html]official website[/url]]
